prompt:
Act as expert (professor) with degree in mathematics. 
Write full-scale 10000-words essay about Advanced Mathematical aspects of Pan–Tompkins algorithm. Be verbose and forward looking. More formulas!
Math=true
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most closely matches the actual Pan–Tompkins algorithm’s standard mathematical structure (bandpass filtering, five-point derivative, squaring, moving-window integration, and the common adaptive threshold update), though it is truncated before finishing the essay. Candidate 2 includes some correct components (e.g., general pipeline and some formulas) but makes a major incorrect claim about the differentiator and adds unverifiable performance/parameter “improvements” (e.g., specific accuracy gains), reducing correctness. Candidate 3 is largely nonsensical and heavily hallucinatory with invented mathematical constructs and unsupported “ratios.” Candidate 4 is more readable, but it incorrectly attributes advanced tools (SVD/QR/Lorenz dynamics) and introduces non-standard operators as if they were part of Pan–Tompkins, making it substantially inaccurate and incomplete.
